ei.subject: 수능특강

fullPassage: While many studies have described the potential benefits of urban agriculture, there is a need for more research that measures the impact of urban agriculture on food access, nutrition, and income generation; explores the potential of urban agriculture to alleviate global challenges such as climate change and biodiversity loss; and suggests ways to maximize the benefits of urban agriculture in relation to these issues. Botanical gardens can use emerging research in these areas to inform programmatic approaches. In addition, researchers are exploring growing practices that can maximize production in urban spaces. Botanical gardens may be able to contribute to this work as well as play a role in educating urban gardeners and farmers about recommended practices for their regions, particularly in the midst of a changing global climate. Finally, botanical gardens can benefit by sharing urban agriculture resources and approaches with one another, including lessons learned in program design, site design and operation, and partnership development to promote effective community engagement.

questions.passage: While many studies have described the (A)[potential / minimal] benefits of urban agriculture, there is a need for more research that measures the impact of urban agriculture on food access, nutrition, and income generation; explores the potential of urban agriculture to (B)[alleviate / aggravate] global challenges such as climate change and biodiversity loss; and suggests ways to (C)[maximize / minimize] the benefits of urban agriculture in relation to these issues. Botanical gardens can use emerging research in these areas to inform programmatic approaches. In addition, researchers are exploring growing practices that can maximize production in urban spaces. Botanical gardens may be able to contribute to this work as well as play a role in educating urban gardeners and farmers about recommended practices for their regions, particularly in the midst of a changing global climate. Finally, botanical gardens can benefit by sharing urban agriculture resources and approaches with one another, including lessons learned in program design, site design and operation, and partnership development to promote effective community engagement.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) potential(잠재적인) - (B) alleviate(완화하다) - (C) maximize(극대화하다)
det.analysis:
✅ ① potential - alleviate - maximize = 원문과 일치 ←정답
❌ ② minimal(최소한의): 도시 농업의 '잠재적' 이점이라는 원문과 다름
❌ ③ aggravate(악화시키다): 기후 변화 같은 도전을 '완화한다'는 원문과 정반대
❌ ④ minimize(최소화하다): 도시 농업의 이점을 '극대화하다'는 원문과 반대
det.tip: potential benefits(잠재적 이점), alleviate global challenges(세계적 도전을 완화하다), maximize the benefits(이점을 극대화하다)가 핵심 어휘이다.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) inform(알리다) - (B) contribute(기여하다) - (C) promote(촉진하다)
det.analysis:
❌ ① surrender(항복하다): 식물원이 이 작업에 '기여할 수 있다'는 원문과 반대
❌ ② ignore(무시하다): 연구를 활용해 접근법에 '정보를 제공한다'는 원문과 반대
❌ ③ hinder(방해하다): 지역사회 참여를 '촉진한다'는 원문과 정반대
✅ ④ inform - contribute - promote = 원문과 일치 ←정답
det.tip: inform programmatic approaches(프로그램적 접근에 정보를 제공하다), contribute to this work(이 작업에 기여하다), promote effective community engagement(효과적 지역사회 참여를 촉진하다)가 핵심이다.

det.korean: ③ minimize(최소화하다) → maximize(극대화하다)

det.analysis:
❌ ① possible(가능한): potential과 유사한 방향
❌ ② likely(그럴 듯한): potential과 유사한 의미
❌ ③ probable(개연성 있는): potential과 같은 방향
✅ ④ actual(실제의): potential의 반의어로 가장 적절 ←정답
det.tip: potential(잠재적인) ↔ actual(실제의). 아직 실현되지 않은 가능성 vs 이미 현실인 것의 대비이다.

questions.passage: While many studies have described the potential benefits of urban agriculture, there is a need for more research that measures the impact of urban agriculture on food access, nutrition, and income generation; explores the potential of urban agriculture to alleviate global challenges such as climate change and biodiversity loss; and suggests ways to maximize the benefits of urban agriculture in relation to these issues. Botanical gardens can use emerging research in these areas to inform programmatic approaches. In addition, researchers are exploring growing practices that can maximize production in urban spaces. Botanical gardens may be able to contribute to this work as well as play a role in educating urban gardeners and farmers about recommended practices for their regions, particularly in the midst of a changing global climate. Finally, botanical gardens can benefit by sharing urban agriculture resources and approaches with one another, including lessons learned in program design, site design and operation, and partnership development to <u>promote</u> effective community engagement.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 promote와 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.korean: 촉진하다 ↔ 억제하다
det.analysis:
❌ ① encourage(격려하다): promote와 유의어
❌ ② advance(전진시키다): promote와 유사한 방향
✅ ③ suppress(억제하다): promote의 반의어로 가장 적절 ←정답
❌ ④ support(지지하다): promote와 유사한 방향
det.tip: promote(촉진하다) ↔ suppress(억제하다) / hinder(방해하다). 적극적으로 밀어주는 것 vs 억누르는 것의 대비이다.

questions.passage:
(A) Botanical gardens can use emerging research in these areas to inform programmatic approaches.

(B) The teacher asked the students to inform her immediately if they noticed anything unusual.
questions.stem: 다음 (A), (B)의 밑줄 친 inform의 의미로 가장 적절하게 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) inform = '영향을 주다, 근거가 되다' (연구가 접근법에 정보를 제공한다) / (B) inform = '알리다' (선생님에게 알리다)
det.analysis:
❌ ① (A)는 '알리다'가 아니라 '(정보를 제공하여) 형성하다/영향을 주다'의 뜻
✅ ② (A) 영향을 주다 - (B) 알리다 = 각 문맥에 정확히 부합 ←정답
❌ ③ (A)에서 inform은 단순 통보가 아닌 '근거가 되다'의 의미
❌ ④ (B)에서 inform은 학생이 선생님에게 '통보하다'의 의미
det.tip: inform은 '알리다'(notify)와 '영향을 주다/근거가 되다'(shape, guide) 두 가지 의미가 있다. 본문에서는 후자로 쓰였다.

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "the variety of plant and animal life in a particular habitat or in the world as a whole"

det.korean: 생물 다양성 — 특정 서식지 또는 전 세계의 동식물 생명의 다양성
det.analysis:
❌ ① agriculture(농업): 작물 재배 및 가축 사육이며 생명의 다양성과 다름
❌ ② nutrition(영양): 음식 섭취에 관한 것이며 생명 다양성과 무관
❌ ③ climate(기후): 장기 기상 패턴이며 생명 다양성과 다른 개념
✅ ④ biodiversity(생물 다양성): 동식물 생명의 다양성이라는 정의에 정확히 부합 ←정답
det.tip: biodiversity = biological diversity. 본문에서 biodiversity loss(생물 다양성 손실)로 쓰였다.

questions.passage: In addition, researchers are exploring growing practices that can maximize production in urban spaces. Botanical gardens may be able to contribute to this work as well as play a role in __________ (educate) urban gardeners and farmers about recommended practices for their regions.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: 전치사 in 뒤에 동명사 형태가 필요하다.
det.analysis: 전치사 'in' 뒤에는 동명사가 와야 하므로 동사 'educate'를 동명사 'educating'으로 바꿔야 한다. 'play a role in educating'은 '교육하는 데 역할을 하다'라는 뜻이다.
det.tip: play a role in + V-ing (~하는 데 역할을 하다) 구문이다. 전치사 in 뒤에 동명사가 온다.

questions.passage: While many studies have described the potential benefits of urban agriculture, there is a need for more research that measures the impact of urban agriculture on food access, nutrition, and income __________. (generate)
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: 명사 income과 병렬 구조로 명사 형태가 필요하다.
det.analysis: 'food access, nutrition, and income generation'에서 income은 명사이고, 뒤에 오는 단어도 명사 형태여야 and로 연결된 병렬 구조가 완성된다. 동사 'generate'를 명사 'generation'으로 변환해야 한다. 'income generation'은 '소득 창출'이라는 뜻의 복합명사이다.
det.tip: 동사 generate → 명사 generation. income generation(소득 창출)은 복합명사 구조이다.

questions.passage: While many studies have described the potential benefits of urban agriculture, there is a need for more research that measures the impact of urban agriculture on food access, nutrition, and income generation; explores the potential of urban agriculture to alleviate global challenges such as __________; and suggests ways to maximize the benefits of urban agriculture in relation to these issues. Botanical gardens can use emerging research in these areas to inform programmatic approaches. In addition, researchers are exploring growing practices that can maximize production in urban spaces. Botanical gardens may be able to contribute to this work as well as play a role in educating urban gardeners and farmers about recommended practices for their regions, particularly in the midst of a changing global climate. Finally, botanical gardens can benefit by sharing urban agriculture resources and approaches with one another, including lessons learned in program design, site design and operation, and partnership development to promote effective community engagement.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 기후 변화와 생물 다양성 손실 — 도시 농업이 완화할 수 있는 세계적 도전의 예시
det.analysis:
❌ ① food production and urban planning(식량 생산과 도시 계획): 본문에서 이를 global challenges의 예시로 제시하지 않음
✅ ② climate change and biodiversity loss(기후 변화와 생물 다양성 손실): 도시 농업이 완화할 수 있는 세계적 도전의 예시로 원문에 정확히 언급 ←정답
❌ ③ economic growth and job creation(경제 성장과 일자리 창출): 본문에서 이를 global challenges로 다루지 않음
❌ ④ water pollution and soil erosion(수질 오염과 토양 침식): 본문에 언급되지 않은 내용
det.tip: global challenges such as climate change and biodiversity loss(기후 변화와 생물 다양성 손실 같은 세계적 도전)이 원문의 정확한 표현이다.

questions.passage: While many studies have described the potential benefits of urban agriculture, there is a need for more research that measures the impact of urban agriculture on food access, nutrition, and income generation; explores the potential of urban agriculture to alleviate global challenges such as climate change and biodiversity loss; and suggests ways to maximize the benefits of urban agriculture in relation to these issues. Botanical gardens can use emerging research in these areas to inform programmatic approaches. In addition, researchers are exploring growing practices that can maximize production in urban spaces. Botanical gardens may be able to contribute to this work as well as play a role in educating urban gardeners and farmers about recommended practices for their regions, particularly in the midst of a changing global climate. Finally, botanical gardens can benefit by sharing urban agriculture resources and approaches with one another, including __________, and partnership development to promote effective community engagement.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 프로그램 설계, 현장 설계 및 운영에서 얻은 교훈 — 식물원 간 공유하는 구체적 내용
det.analysis:
❌ ① strategies for reducing agricultural waste and pollution: 본문에서 언급되지 않은 농업 폐기물 감소 전략
❌ ② techniques for genetic modification of urban crops: 본문에서 다루지 않은 유전자 변형 기술
✅ ③ lessons learned in program design, site design and operation: 식물원 간 공유하는 내용으로 원문에 정확히 일치 ←정답
❌ ④ methods for replacing traditional farming with technology: 본문에서 전통 농업 대체를 다루지 않음
det.tip: lessons learned in program design, site design and operation(프로그램 설계, 현장 설계 및 운영에서 얻은 교훈)은 식물원 간 공유의 구체적 예시이다.
